    Strict induction through ray residue categories #

    Package the finite induction which annihilates one maximal nonzero ray at a time. The only local input is an invisible correction on every maximal ray; the principal residue has strictly fewer nonzero morphisms, and the concrete morphism-depth rank closes the lift from quotient exactness.

    source

            Source-faithful strict residue induction. A nontrivial contour supplies one arrow and hence a singleton tackle; maximize its efficiency at the same start, annihilate a maximal path through the efficient tackle's last arrow, and recurse on the strictly smaller residue.
